name: Subsurface Excess Ice Scarps (Site AP-Alpha)
objective: Inspect shallow buried water-ice margins exposed by thermokarst scarp retreat for ISRU water extraction.
description: Flat-lying Amazonian plains exhibiting scalloped depressions and polygonal ground indicative of shallow subsurface excess ice.
source_references: USGS SIM 3292 (Tanaka et al., 2014) Unit lAp

name: Expanded Secondary Crater Cluster (Site AP-Beta)
objective: Measure ejecta morphology and crater rim sublimation to estimate ice table depth.
description: Rimless expanded secondary craters characteristic of ice-rich regolith sublimation in central Arcadia Planitia.
